axis: a bare rate of happening → speed marked as excessive and careless

members.tone: The plain word for speed that has got ahead of itself, and it leaves the carelessness a risk rather than a verdict.
Graver and more formal than *hurry* - the over-eagerness sounds like a fault being named, with the carelessness pressing right behind it.
The bare measure of how fast something happens, with none of the reproach that *haste* attaches to the same quickness.
Names that same rate as a quality something possesses, so it carries a lift of admiration where *speed* stays a flat reading.
